name: Handwoven sabai grass storage baskets, set of 3 (Odisha handicraft)
supplier_cost_note: Craft Vista Pvt Ltd, Baripada (Mayurbhanj, Odisha): multicolour round sabai grass basket Rs 120/piece, 'various sizes' (IndiaMART similar-products panel and ExportersIndia, seen 2026-10-22) x 3 = Rs 360. Size per price NOT confirmed; larger Odisha listings run higher: Utkalika Bhubaneswar 7-8 in Rs 269/piece (MOQ 70), Kalaghar Bhubaneswar Rs 310, Craft Vista Rs 380 -> realistic range Rs 360-807 for 3. Get a nested-set quote.
retail_observed: Comparable sets: The India Craft House sabai set of 2 Rs 750; Natriel set of 3 Rs 1,479 (out of stock); Amazon.in handcrafted sabai set of 3 (30/26/20 cm) Rs 1,763; single lidded baskets on Amazon.in Rs 349-499 (Naushad Rs 349, Natriel Rs 499). Seen 2026-10-22 via search snapshots.

risks: Supplier cost assumes the Rs 120 listing covers all 3 sizes; if nested sizes cost Rs 269-310 each the set fails at Rs 999
Volumetric weight of a 30 cm basket may push courier slab above le_1kg
Handmade: colour/size variation -> 'not as pictured' returns
GST: HSN 4602 basketwork; may be 5% after Sept-2025 handicraft rate cut - CA to confirm (12% used to stay conservative)
Odisha supplier: GST-local, good for ITC and pickup

review.notes: Deciding fact unconfirmed: the Rs 120/piece Craft Vista price has no size, and Craft Vista's own searchable listings are Rs 250-350/piece (ExportersIndia, IndiaMART woven-basket panel) - at a set cost above about Rs 430 the set fails 30% at Rs 999 (Rs 500 -> 21.6%, Rs 750 -> -7.6%; even Rs 1,499 at Rs 750 cost only reaches 23.4%). Retail for sets of 3 is Rs 1,763-1,995 so price room exists, but get a written quote for the exact nested 3-size set (dimensions, nested packed box size for volumetric weight) plus photos before any sample; handmade colour/size variation must be stated in the listing.
